newsitem.title: USA: Health Care investments reach $105 mln.
newsitem.headline: Health Care investments reach $105 mln.

text.p: Health Care Property Investors Inc Monday said its 1997 real estate investments currently total $105 million versus $121 million for all of 1996.
The investments include $74 million in 13 assisted living facilities, $10 million in two long term acute care hospitals and $21 million in a physician group practice clinic.

The properties are leased to nine different operators in seven different states. About half of the investments are in existing facilities. The rest are construction projects that are expected to be finished in the next 12 months.
